ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jan-23-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: Gina Gonzales, CSR: Beldon Yee.
Petitioner: Ann Akichika, present in pro per as Guardian Ad Litem for Minor: Ryan Michael Tabibian, was sworn and examined. Appearance of Co-Petitioner/Minor's father was waived.
Petitioner Ann Akichika presented to the court a valid ID.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Ryan Manouchehr Tabibian.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jan-09-2007 Reset To Jan-23-07 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha/Gina Gonzales, CSR: Jacqueline Chan.
Petitioner: Ali Tabibian, present as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Ryan Michael Tabibian, was sworn and examined.
No appearance by Co-Petitioner: Ann Akichika.
Matter is continued to Jan. 23, 2007 at 9:00 A.M. in Dept. 218, for appearance with proper I.D., and for further examination of the Co-Petitioner: Akichika.
Appearance of Mr. Tabibian is waived.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
